scope: Static Toolkit 1.18 KEYE secondary-application mask and group-resolution analysis plus bounded cached/native Python projection. The original executable was not executed and no database, CNI or physical device was accessed.

static_facts.mask: LoadUnitGroupAddresses reads SecondApplicationBlocks, tests bit 1<<block_index for every input block and records the resulting Boolean on the block. SaveSecondApplicationBlocks reconstructs the same bits and stores only the low byte.
static_facts.resolution: GetBlockGroup selects Application2 when the block Boolean is true; otherwise it selects the block's primary application. It resolves the indexed GroupAddress in that application's manager with creation enabled.
static_facts.ordering: LoadGroups iterates the input-block collection in order, resolves each block through GetBlockGroup and appends every non-nil group to the unit group manager in that same order.
static_facts.ninth_slot: KEYE retains nine stored GroupAddress values but SecondApplicationBlocks is one byte, so only zero-based blocks 0 through 7 can select the secondary application. Slot 8 remains primary and is outside the eight-slot CSV interaction predicate.

implemented_behavior.same_address_groups: Primary and secondary groups with the same byte address remain distinct through OID or canonical application path identity.
implemented_behavior.validation: A nonzero secondary block mask with application255 is rejected before projection; every selected group must exist in its selected application cache.
implemented_behavior.output: The report carries the configured secondary application tag and uses each first-eight block's selected-application group tag. The ninth and later report columns remain unavailable.
